thread:
anya: Follow-up from this morning's postmortem. We need owners and dates for remediation and tests (regression entries, incident prompt sets, load/chaos drills). Quick check-in.

tom: I can take the regression work. Plan: add 8 failing prompts to nightly fast suite and create a separate longseq job for the 2 longest cases. ETA PR by Wed.

leila: I'll curate the incident prompt set and tag expected outputs + severity. CSV format: id,input,expected,severity. Will upload by Fri EOD.

omar: I'll run the targeted load spike to reproduce memory-pressure pattern. Need a CAP for 2 sandbox nodes. Can schedule Tue morning.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: attach SLO targets to the drill playbook and include rollback criteria.

anya: Tom/Leila/Omar please paste GH/ticket links here when created. I'll add items to the remediation kanban and make a recurring monthly "incident-driven evals" reminder.

tom: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5233 (regression additions). Includes minor harness flag.

leila: Uploaded CSV: evals/incident-sets/INC-2033.csv and filed issue https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/97

omar: CAP-2162 created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/CAP-2162. Sandbox nodes requested. Drill invite sent for Tue 09:00 PT.

anya: Great. We'll run the drill, run the updated regressions after deploy, and reconvene in the post-drill sync. Add any blockers now.

eng-sre-bot: Deploy window reminder: keep canary gated; ops will monitor p95 latency and fallback success.

leila: One minor note: I'll tag high-severity prompts so gating checks fail if regressions recur.

tom: Acknowledged. I'll wire the gating check to block canary if high-severity cases fail.

anya: Thanks everyone — posting this into the postmortem doc and closing the loop.
